text:
alex: Heads-up — around 10:12 UTC we saw mass preemptive drains in us-west1. Allocator marked ~12 hosts unhealthy after heartbeat drops, spilled tenants, and triggered fallback routing. Impacted shared pools and a couple of dedicated slices. cost spike on a few tenants (kv-cache regen).

maya: Oof. Any obvious correlator — deploy, network, control-plane?

alex: No deploys at that minute. Attaching short excerpt from allocator: 
```
2026-03-23T10:12:13Z allocator INFO host=rack-12 host_id=node-gpu-33 heartbeat_missed=1
2026-03-23T10:12:14Z allocator WARN host=node-gpu-33 mark_unhealthy reason=heartbeat_timeout
2026-03-23T10:12:15Z allocator INFO evicting_slices=[tenant-123, tenant-457] policy=preemptive_drain
```

riley: I saw netstack errors from gpu-33 earlier: `mlx5: VF reset` and NIC link flaps in dmesg. Could be NIC firmware or cable?

sam: Also saw a tiny spike in etcd leader election around the same time (10:11-10:13). Might be two independent signals causing the allocator to be overly sensitive.

maya: If allocator triggers on a single heartbeat miss + etcd jitter + NIC flap we should debounce. Suggest immediate mitigation: increase heartbeat grace from 3s->10s and require 2 consecutive misses for preemptive drain. Minimal config change we can revert quickly.

alex: Agreed. Also need to protect high-SLA dedicated pools from automatic preemptive drains while we triage (they're scheduled for churn). Sam, can you whitelist them for 1h?

sam: On it. Running patch now: 
```bash
./ctl allocator update-policy --whitelist-pools dedicated-usw-prod --ttl 3600 --reason "temp protect while investigating heartbeat flaps"
```

infra-bot: deploy-bot: policy patch applied by sam; id=patch-1758882022; change=whitelist dedicated-usw-prod for 3600s.

oncall-rotation: I'm on-call, pinged hw-team for a physical check of rack-12 (cables/firmware). Also raising an incident if we see >5% p99 regression persisting.

riley: I'll pull NIC firmware/version across the rack and check for host kernel changes from last week. Command I'm running: 
```bash
for n in node-gpu-{30..36}; do ssh $n sudo ethtool -i eth0; done
```

maya: Long-term we should make preemptive drains require anti-entropy: both allocator health AND scheduler network health signal OR disk/host heartbeats. For now, debounce + whitelist. Also add KV-cache hit-rate alert so regen cost spike is visible before customer impact.

alex: Noted. I'll post a short postmortem template once we have full timelines. For now: 1) whitelist dedicated pools (sam) 2) bump heartbeat grace / 2-miss debounce (maya) 3) hw check on rack-12 (oncall) 4) KV-cache alert added (alex/riley).

sam: Done with whitelist. Patch id in infra-bot. Rolling heartbeat grace now (5s->12s) in staging allocator, will canary in 2 zones before us-west.

riley: Collected NIC info, firmware on node-gpu-33 is `mlx5_core 5.5.1` — nothing recently upgraded on that host. HW team requested we hold on a full reboot until they confirm cable/PSU.

alex: Thanks all. If anyone sees another heartbeat cluster within next 30m ping this thread and @oncall-rotation. I'll start the incident doc if we see re-occurrence. :thumbsup:

maya: Adding quick runbook note: `if preemptive evictions > 3 hosts in 5m -> throttle preemptive drains and open incident`. Will PR in 15m.

oncall-rotation: Acknowledged. HW team en route to datacenter. Keeping this thread updated. :boom:
